outputs.name: Deliver the four controller facings of the robot (south preserved, east/north/west from the reviewed sample)

requirements.name: continuity
requirements.check: Viewed together at 1x and 3x in one 32x32 cell each, the four facings share the same robot: equal height and ground line, the same navy frame / teal body / pale-yellow eye colours, consistent antenna posts, and a box volume that turns coherently S->E->N->W without a facing looking like a different object or size.
requirements.reason: Viewed together at 1x and 3x the four facings share the same robot: equal height (rows 3-27) and ground line, the same navy/teal/pale-yellow colours, consistent 6-px posts, and a box that turns coherently south (front) -> east (front edge right) -> north (back) -> west (front edge left); no facing reads as a different object or size.

requirements.name: direction_mapping
requirements.check: Each file at the controller path spriteFor(facing) shows that facing: assets/robot/south.png front, east.png right, north.png back, west.png left.
requirements.reason: In the renderer's actual spriteFor(facing) rows, south.png shows the front, east.png the right profile, north.png the back and west.png the left profile.

requirements.name: renderer_mechanical
requirements.check: renderer-native/check.py reports pass for a capture made from the delivered files with the unchanged controller: all four facings mapped, 32x32 RGBA transparent, south bytes identical to the base, screenshot pixels match the expected nearest-scaled composites.
requirements.reason: renderer-check-01.json reports pass with no failures for capture render-01 made from the delivered files with the unchanged controller (mapping, 32x32 RGBA transparency, south byte identity, pixel and screenshot checks).

requirements.name: renderer_visual
requirements.check: destination.png and every 1x and 3x cell of that capture, viewed with the host image tool, show the four facings rendered crisply (nearest) over the observation background, transparent around the robot, without resampling blur, cropping or misplacement.
requirements.reason: destination.png and all eight 1x/3x cells were viewed: crisp nearest rendering over #172336, transparent around the robot, no blur, cropping or misplacement.
